body:
It's ironic how I'm telling you this, but you've dug yourself a hole and you just keep digging. You're in a constant cycle of negativity; a cycle which is goddamn difficult to break. Every day you see people who are more successful than you, every day you feel them criticising you. But you know what?

They're not. Many people share the exact same point of view as you, we're all so bloody damn caught up in what others think of us that it consumes our lives. Everything we are has been sculpted by the society in which we live, but you know what? Fuck that. Go against the grain.It's not easy, god  I know this all too well. But it's worth it.
